'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 John Veasey DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
